description: MainActivity.kt defines the MainActivity class responsible for toggling the device flashlight using Android's Camera2 API. It manages UI interactions, permission handling, and camera torch state monitoring.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity provides a UI to toggle the device flashlight, handling camera permissions, callbacks, and UI updates accordingly.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, UI, camera manager, and sets up torch callback and button listener.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Registers torch callback and updates UI when activity starts.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Turns off the torch upon pausing the activity.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Unregisters torch callback to prevent leaks when stopping.

methods.name: handleToggleClick
methods.description: Handles user click to toggle flashlight, managing permission requests as needed.

methods.name: requestCameraPermissionIfNeeded
methods.description: Requests camera permission if not granted, using runtime permission API.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles the result of permission requests and retries toggling if granted.

methods.name: retryToggleAfterPermission
methods.description: Attempts to toggle torch after permission is granted.

methods.name: turnTorchSafe
methods.description: Safely turns the torch on or off, suppressing exceptions.

methods.name: turnTorchInternal
methods.description: Sets the torch mode on the camera manager and updates internal state.

methods.name: findBackCameraWithFlash
methods.description: Identifies the back-facing camera with flash support.

methods.name: registerTorchCallbackSafe
methods.description: Registers or unregisters torch callbacks with exception handling.

methods.name: updateUi
methods.description: Updates the toggle button UI based on torch and camera availability.
